notes.title: Deep Abyss 1.12 patch
notes.notes:
For this update, we tried to fix the feedback we received in the meantime as much as possible.
We will always be faithful to feedback with an open mind.

- New tutorial applied.
- Newly modified and supplemented the difficulty level for each level.
- Modify and complement the video scene for each level.
- Other bug fixes.

notes.title: Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Tutorial corrections and supplements.

Other bug fixes
